mismo.label: November 18, 2026
mismo.title: AI Governance Crosswalk: Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac and MISMO’s FRAME
mismo.fullTitle: AI Governance Crosswalk: Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac and MISMO’s FRAME
mismo.summary: This session offers a practical crosswalk of Fannie Mae’s and Freddie Mac’s AI governance requirements and MISMO’s FRAME (Framework for Responsible AI in the Mortgage Ecosystem). MISMO President Brian Vieaux will moderate a conversation with MISMO Members James Brody of Brody Gapp LLP; Brooke Anderson Tompkins, CEO of Bridge AIvisory; and Suha Zehl, CEO of Z Technology Solutions. The panel will examine where the GSE requirements align, where they differ, and how FRAME can help organizations build and strengthen their governance programs.

mismo.label: December 8, 2026
mismo.title: Introducing the MISMO eHELOC Standard and FAQ
mismo.fullTitle: Introducing the MISMO eHELOC Standard and FAQ
mismo.summary: As eHELOC adoption continues to grow, understanding the underlying technology, legal framework, and implementation considerations is essential. This webinar explores the fundamentals of eHELOCs, including SMART Docs®, legal credibility, using remote online notarization in an eHELOC transaction while introducing the new MISMO eHELOC FAQ as a practical resource for answering common questions and promoting consistent industry practices. Date and Time : Tuesday, December 8 (12:00 PM - 1:00 PM ET)
